protocol.policy: All configurations: internal 15% site holdout chooses epoch, fresh full-permitted refit max(epoch,10), original 150-epoch LR/Huber schedule; no architecture or loss search.
protocol.upstream: Fixed v6 nested 5 cm inputs, indexed by outer fold; conditional downstream input experiment, not upstream retraining. Outer OOF and external sites remain excluded from upstream gradient/selection/preprocessing. Inner target-depth epoch selection uses these fixed upstream features.
protocol.source_history: Post-hoc hypothesis motivated by prior repeated examination of this test set; new OOF freeze is not prospective untouched-test validation.
protocol.reuse: A reuses verified floor-10 weights; B reuses original no-cascade fits only where selected epochs >=10, otherwise same preprocessor and initialisation refit 10. C and D perform their own internal epoch selection and floor-10 refit.
protocol.ranking: Lowest mean of the three per-seed OOF pooled RMSE values; exact tie resolved A,B,C,D. Rank all four before any new test inference. Report equal-site RMSE and anomaly correlation separately; no automatic product promotion.

bootstrap.method: Percentile resampling of whole physical-site clusters with all records and multiplicity; identical site draws across seeds and configurations; pointwise conditional intervals, no multiplicity adjustment.

protocol.test_gate: Fit stage reads train and OOF only; freeze all fitted weights, preprocessors and OOF predictions plus OOF ranking before test inference for every configuration.
protocol.product_and_manuscripts: Remain unchanged during this input experiment.
